name: branding-embossed-ceramic-bowls-trio-on-black
title: Three ceramic bowls on black: two upturned showing an embossed monogram, one upright with an olive glaze
whatItIs: A top-down photo on pure black of three matte white bowls in a row: the outer two upside down showing a debossed ornamental monogram on the foot, the centre one upright with an olive-gold glazed interior and the same mark pressed in.
whatItMeans: Quiet luxury; the logo is felt rather than printed, so the brand lives in the material.
techniques: Deboss the logo into the product itself.
Shoot a symmetrical row on black for drama.
Break the pattern with one item flipped to reveal colour.

vocabulary.definition: Pressing a design into a surface so it sits below it.
The base ring on the underside of a bowl.
